page.layout: One column of dictionary entries (Hebrew lexicon), running head centred at top, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Dilatant, scilicet matricem aut ventrem ad pullos edendos, Job.39.6.
פָּלַח m. Fragmentum, Segmentum, 1.Sam.30.v.12. Cantic.4.3. כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּית Sicut fragmen inferioris, scil. molæ, Job.41.15.

פלח Chald. Servivit, Coluit: Partic. פָּלְחָה Colis eum, Dan.6.v.17. Plural. פָּלְחִין Colunt, Dan.3.12. Construct. פָּלְחֵי Servientibus, Ministris domus Dei, Esr.7.24. Futur. די לָא יִפְלְחוּן Ut non colerent, Dan.3.28.

פלט Evasit, Effugit: Præt. וּפְלָטוּ Et evadent, Ezech. 7.16. Pih פַּלֵּט Evadere fecit, Liberavit, Eripuit: Item, Parere, Eniti. Partic. וּמְפַלְּטִי Et liberator meus, Psal.18.3. Infinit. רְנִי פַּלֵּט Cantionibus liberandi, pro, Liberationu, Psal.32.7: Imperat. פַּלְּטֻנִי Parito eu, Psal.56.8. vel, Liberare seu Liberatio eis? admirative juxta Kimchium. Cum ה paragogico, פַּלְטָה נַפְשִׁי Eripe animam meam, Psalm.17.13. Futur. תִּפְלֹט פַּרְתּוֹ Enititur vacca ejus, Job.21.10. Hiph. Futur. וַיְפַלֵּיט Et eripiet, Jesa.5.29. וְלֹא־תַפְלִיט Sed non liberabis, Mich.6.14.

פָּלִיט m. Profugus, Evadens, Effugiens, Qui evasit aut elapsus est, Amos 9. v.1. Plural. per Tzere in medio, פְּלֵיטִים Evadentes, Jesa.66.19. פְּלֵטִים מֵחֶרֶב Evadentes à gladio, Jerem.51.50. Constr. פְּלֵיטֵי חֶרֶב Evasores gladii, Ezech.6 8. Aff. פְּלֵיטֵיכֶם Evasores vestri, Qui evaserint ex vobis, Ezech.6.9.
פְּלֵיטָה f. Evasio, Effugium, Liberatio, Residuum, Reliquiæ; Tria sunt absq; ' in medio, פלטה, Ezech.14. v.22. Jud.21.17. 2.Sam.15.14. Constr. פְּלֵיטַת Residuum: 2.Reg.19.30.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Latin abbreviations in the entries are hard to read at this scan resolution and may be inexact; the consonantal forms are the most reliable. The Hebrew headword "פלט" at the top of the entry of "פלט" and some of the Latin italics are approximate. The Latin "Liberare seu Liberatio eis?" and "Tria sunt absq;" lines are as printed and may contain printing errors. Dust marks at the bottom of the page were ignored.
